Notify.Name: Notifications
Notify.Hint: Tell players when someone or some place new is added, gets a picture, or a note is shared with them.

PlayersCanAdd.Name: Players can add NPCs and places
PlayersCanAdd.Hint: Let players add people and places to Familiar Faces & Places themselves (Add NPC and Add place buttons, right-click on a selected name). Portraits and pictures stay GM-only.

ImageFolder.Name: Picture upload folder
ImageFolder.Hint: Where uploaded portraits and place pictures are saved. Empty: worlds/<world>/familiar-faces.

SelectionMenu.Name: Right-click selected names
SelectionMenu.Hint: Right-clicking a selected name in a journal offers to add it to Familiar Faces or Familiar Places. Hold Shift for the normal menu.

ImageMenu.Name: Right-click journal images (GM)
ImageMenu.Hint: Right-clicking an image in a journal offers to use it as the portrait of an NPC or the picture of a place. Hold Shift for the normal menu.

KnownNameplates.Name: Show the names of NPCs the party knows
KnownNameplates.Hint: When an NPC is in every player's Familiar Faces, all tokens of that NPC (in every scene, and new ones) show their name to everyone on hover. Needs a GM logged in; names are never hidden again by the module.

TokenMenu.Name: Right-click NPC tokens
TokenMenu.Hint: Players: right-clicking an NPC's token offers to add them to your own Familiar Faces (hold Shift to skip it). GM: a Familiar Faces button on NPC token HUDs adds them for all players.
